Post Date: 2020-12-10T15:15:23Z

Title:  fluent-bit_1.6.8.bb: FLB_IN_SYSTEMD input plugin not included
Description: ## Bug Report

**Describe the bug**
Build option FLB_IN_SYSTEMD=On is not taken into account when building via fluent-bit_1.6.8.bb yocto bitbake. Also tried global option `FLB_ALL=Yes` without success.

Steps to Reproduce:
- Add `EXTRA_OECMAKE += "-DFLB_IN_SYSTEMD=On "` to bitbake recipe and build `bitbake fluent-bit`

Errors:
- `fluent-bit --help` does not display input option `systemd` and Build Flags are not shown
- `fluent-bit -i systemd -o stdout` displays `Error: Invalid input type. Aborting`
